title: How a Man of God Brings Up Faith on a First Date Without Preaching
caption:
Hiding your faith on a first date is a quiet kind of lying. Preaching at her is a loud kind of pride.

There's a plain middle: say it like a fact, then get curious about her.

Send this to a brother with a date this weekend.

#faith #dating #godlyman #relationships
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
